info.name: JusticeFlow API — Server (Complete)
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the JusticeFlow backend (Police–Court Case Management System).

## Coverage
Every backend route is included, grouped by module:

- **System** — root info, health check
- **Auth** — login, current user
- **Organizations** — police stations, courts, officers
- **FIR** — create FIR (multipart, optional upload), get FIR
- **Cases** — my/all/list, detail, assign, complete investigation, archive, judicial close, can-close, reopen request
- **Investigation** — events, evidence (multipart), witnesses (multipart), accused
- **Documents** — create (multipart), list, finalize
- **Court** — submit-to-court, intake, court actions
- **Bail** — create/list bail applications
- **Audit Logs** — per-case audit trail
- **Document Requests** — full police→SHO→court approval & issue workflow
- **Timeline** — case timeline
- **Search** — global search
- **Closure Report** — generate/get PDF report
- **Case Reopen** — police request, judge approve/reject
- **AI** — index, search, chat, OCR, draft, enhanced AI suite, case-readiness / document-validate / case-brief
- **Analytics** — dashboard stats

## Getting Started
1. Start the server: `cd server && npm run dev` (default `http://localhost:5000`)
2. Run **Auth → Login (Officer)** — the token is auto-saved to the `token` collection variable.
3. All protected requests use `{{token}}` automatically.

## Demo Accounts (after `npm run db:seed`)
| Role | Email | Password |
|---|---|---|
| POLICE | officer1@police.gov | password123 |
| SHO | sho.central@police.gov | password123 |
| COURT_CLERK | clerk@court.gov | password123 |
| JUDGE | judge@court.gov | password123 |

## Roles
POLICE · SHO · COURT_CLERK · JUDGE — role middleware enforces access per route.

## Variables
`{{caseId}}`, `{{firId}}`, `{{documentId}}`, `{{accusedId}}`, `{{stationId}}`, `{{courtId}}`, `{{requestId}}`, `{{reopenId}}`, `{{extractionId}}`, `{{officerId}}` — set via tests scripts or manually after creating records.
